## Summary

Keep this PR open: current main does not implement publisher follows, but this draft still needs real behavior proof, public API contract coverage, generated artifact consistency, and maintainer acceptance of the new follow-graph API boundary.

## What This Changes

The PR adds a Convex-backed publisher follow graph with private follow rows, follow/unfollow/list functions, GET/POST/DELETE API-token HTTP routes, route constants, tests, retention policy, and a follow-graph spec.

## Best Possible Solution

Land this API slice only after maintainers accept the follow-graph boundary, docs/OpenAPI and generated artifacts are consistent, and the contributor adds redacted live HTTP or Convex proof for follow, list, and unfollow.
